name: Kiosk display
author: Crow
description: Turn a browser into a home display: your Ramble bird as a voice companion (tap to talk; Crow runs speech-to-text, your chosen bot and text-to-speech), with on-screen timers, recipes and notes. Pair it with a code; tailnet only.
notes: Voice needs an STT profile (the Faster-Whisper bundle; the kiosk adds its own distil-small.en profile at first pairing) and a TTS profile (install the Kokoro TTS bundle for local voice). Reached at https://<host>:8444/display over the tailnet; never through Funnel.
